naId3854726.summary: During the siege of Vicksburg, Johnston passes on Bragg's news that part of the Union 9th and 23d Corps has been sent to reinforce Grant (a telegram from Louisville), and asks Seddon whether this does not allow an invasion of Kentucky, for which Bragg's command should extend over East Tennessee. The words 'invade Kentucky', 'extend' and 'East Tennessee' were enciphered.
naId3854726.en:
Words that were in cipher are in capitals. The telegram is in English, so no translation is given. Notes on "9th, 23d"
and on the sign after "Bragg" are in NOTES.md.

General Bragg informs me that a telegram from Louisville of the 10th says that part of the 9th, 23d Corps have been
sent to reinforce Grant. Will not this enable us to INVADE KENTUCKY? For this General Bragg & should EXTEND over EAST
TENNESSEE.

J. E. Johnston, General.

system: Vigenere on the tabula recta with the key MANCHESTERBLUFF, running across the five enciphered words of an otherwise clear telegram and advancing by plaintext length.
